provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.en: Line height is measured with vocalised text

statement.ar: حدّد ارتفاع السطر لكل خط عربي بعد قياس سطر مشكول تشكيلًا كاملًا فيه حروف صاعدة وهابطة. الحاويات ذات السطر الواحد لا تقص العلامات (لا overflow: hidden على ارتفاع يساوي ارتفاع الخط).
statement.en: Set the line height of each Arabic typeface after measuring a fully vocalised line with ascending and descending letters. Single-line containers must not clip marks (no overflow: hidden on a height equal to the font's).

rationale.ar: الحروف العربية تصعد وتهبط أكثر من اللاتينية، والتشكيل يتراكم فوق الشدّة وتحت الحرف. ارتفاع سطر مناسب للاتينية يقص الضمة والكسرة أو يُدخل سطرين في بعضهما.
rationale.en: Arabic letters rise and descend further than Latin ones, and marks stack above a shadda and below the letter. A line height that suits Latin clips marks or makes two lines collide.

checks: For text-stress TS-052 at every type token, the ink bounding box of each line lies within its line box.
Two consecutive lines of TS-052 have no overlapping ink.
In buttons, inputs, chips and table cells, the ink of TS-050 is not clipped by the element's box.
Line-height tokens for Arabic are unitless and recorded per font with the measured ink extents.
